body: From the DM-182 review (orchestrator, this run): consolidate the duplicated scorecard view helpers into one shared module under src/renderer/src/scorecard/: STATE_LABELS, REASON_LABELS, ROLE_LABELS (byte-identical in epic/epicScorecardView.ts:190-210 and the report scorecard view), outcomeText (DM-182's adds ' · not counted'), ticketNames/TicketNames (different signatures).
